decisions.reason: The aloe vera line sits close to the core offer, has its own page signalling management commitment, and in a growing industry its results likely meet aspirations, so there is no reason for problemistic search.

A hyaluronic serum is a standard, low-cost addition that small in-house production can carry, and in a growing market there is no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations, though its lower visibility suggests slightly more risk of quiet removal.
A cleansing milk is a basic, close-to-core item that completes the facial care range at little extra cost, so absent signs of underperformance management is likely to keep it.
